description: Defines the HpackBlockCollector class used for testing HPACK block decoding in HTTP/2, including methods for collecting, expecting, shuffling, and validating HPACK entries.

classes.name: HpackBlockCollector
classes.description: A class for collecting and testing HPACK entries during HTTP/2 header decoding, supporting expectations, shuffling, and validation.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Handles an indexed header entry callback.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Handles a dynamic table size update callback.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Handles the start of a literal header.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header name.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Handles header name data.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a header name.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header value.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Handles header value data.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a header value.

methods.name: ExpectIndexedHeader
methods.description: Adds an expectation for an indexed header.

methods.name: ExpectDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Adds an expectation for a dynamic table size update.

methods.name: ExpectNameIndexAndLiteralValue
methods.description: Adds an expectation for a header with name index and literal value.

methods.name: ExpectLiteralNameAndValue
methods.description: Adds an expectation for a header with literal name and value.

methods.name: ShuffleEntries
methods.description: Randomly shuffles the collected entries.

methods.name: AppendToHpackBlockBuilder
methods.description: Serializes collected entries into an HpackBlockBuilder.

methods.name: ValidateSoleIndexedHeader
methods.description: Validates that the only entry is an indexed header with the specified index.

methods.name: ValidateSoleDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Validates that the only entry is a dynamic table size update with the specified size.

methods.name: ValidateSoleLiteralValueHeader
methods.description: Validates that the only entry is a header with a literal value.

methods.name: ValidateSoleLiteralNameValueHeader
methods.description: Validates that the only entry is a header with literal name and value.

methods.name: IsNotPending
methods.description: Checks if there is no pending entry.

methods.name: IsClear
methods.description: Checks if the collector is empty and has no pending entry.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all collected entries and pending state.

methods.name: VerifyEq
methods.description: Compares this collector with another for equality.

methods.name: PushPendingEntry
methods.description: Finalizes the current pending entry and adds it to the entries list.
